title: Voice memo
intro_body: Your voice is recorded and attached to this note. Allow microphone access on the next screen.
silent_hint: No sound detected. Check your microphone.
low_time: The file will split soon · about {{min}} min left
transcribing_hint: You can close this — transcription keeps going.
offer_body: Transcribe what you said and add it to the note?
upload_failed: Couldn't upload the recording. It is still kept on this device.
kept_hint: It isn't in the note yet. Add it with “Transcript ready · Insert” on the note's voice attachment.
interrupted: Recording stopped. Everything recorded so far was saved.
confirm_body: What would you like to do with the recording?
err_denied: Microphone access is off. Allow it in your device's app permissions, then try again.
err_busy: Another app is using the microphone. Close it and try again.
err_empty: No sound was recorded. Please try again.
err_unknown: Could not start recording. Please try again.
leave_upload_failed: Some attachments haven't uploaded. If you leave now, photos and files are lost; recordings can be finished the next time you open Voice memo.
uploading_hint: Sending to your PC. It keeps going if you close this.
ready_hint: Upload the recordings below first, or start a new one.
tr_err_key: The AI key was rejected, so it can't transcribe. Check the AI key in Settings.
tr_err_format: The AI didn't accept this recording format. Check the AI model in Settings.
tr_in_progress: It is already being transcribed. The text will appear in the note when done; check again in a moment.
tr_err_deadline: It took too long, so transcription stopped. Try again in a moment. Your recording is safe.
